name: Generator package
summary: A generic generating-package envelope linked to official equipment and installation drawings.
description: A generator package can include the electrical machine, prime mover and equipment defined by its supply scope. Its enclosure and installation interfaces depend on the selected package. The GA must therefore reference the actual product and project equipment scope.

The original envelope illustration is unscaled and has no manufacturer dimensions. Follow the cited public resources to the exact product, then use its current drawing and installation information for engineering work.
readingNotes: Identify which accessories are included in the represented package.
Connect the physical package reference to the electrical source on the SLD.
drawingChecklist: Identify electrical and other installation interfaces.
Link the generator and control schedules.
distinction: A generic generator outline does not define ventilation, exhaust, fuel, acoustic performance or service access requirements.
